annotations.title: Get several short texts at once

description: Fetch many short references in one call (e.g. a list of verses or commentary lines). Returns Hebrew and English for each. Up to 30 references.

refs.description: List of references, e.g. ["Genesis 1:1", "Exodus 20:2", "Rashi on Genesis 1:1:1"].

vowels.description: Hebrew vowels/cantillation: "full" keeps nikud, "none" strips it.

name: get_texts_bulk
